title: One fewer observation per cold OPC Part read, a bounded monitored-read scope, and an allocation-free ZIP member lookup
decision: retained; ZIP-3 and ZIP-4 of the 0587 queue implemented, with ZIP-3's per-site analysis reaching one of five observation sites and saying why the other four stay
reason_codes: lookup_member_name allocated and re-normalized a String on every contains, metadata, entry_id, is_stored, read, read_stored_borrowed, read_entry_to and session admission, at least twice per structural member; a name that is already its own lookup key is now decided by one byte pass and looked up as a borrowed &str, removing 6.32%, 5.93% and 6.59% of the allocations per open on a 132-member XLSX, a 48-member PPTX and a 10-member DOCX

open-plus-one-part instructions fall 3.45%, 2.58% and 2.56% on the same three fixtures (callgrind isolation pairs, N = 1 against N = 11); normalize_str_fallibly falls 71% and the rfind(':') memrchr 23%, against a +1.11M increase inside lookup_member_name itself where the new byte scan is charged

the per-site analysis change 0563 performed reaches exactly one of the five observations a cold part().data() takes: the pre-publication one, which proves a strict subset of the fence taken after the provisional publication, with nothing between them that reads the source and no side effect of its own. The count is 5 to 4, not the 5 to 2 the survey hoped for, and the record states what each surviving site proves that no later site does

change 0317's precedence is preserved by relocating the removed observation onto the publish_pending_with_observer failure branch, after the flight has been completed as failed so the early return leaks no flight and hangs no waiter

monitor_reads latched an AtomicBool that nothing cleared, so one stream_to converted every later positional read on that package into two version() calls for the package's lifetime: eight cold Part reads after a stream cost 102, 88 and 78 observations against 40, 40 and 30 on identical packages that had not streamed. A counted RAII scope over the fifteen sites that set the flag brings both to 32, 32 and 24

change 0327's publication protocol never reads monitor_reads: its fences are direct ensure_current() calls, so bounding the flag cannot weaken it, and what the flag does guarantee is a per-chunk fence during an incremental copy, which the scope now covers exactly

walk_relationship_graph built the visited key three times per graph node; the re-insert at pop time is replaced by a get_mut through the key enqueue_target already inserted, and the remaining copy no longer routes the name through Display

accepted_evidence.counts: exact source-observation, allocation, allocated-byte, positional-request and requested-byte counts for open, first and second Part read, all Parts in both physical orders, stream_to, the cold reads that follow a stream on the same package, and the same reads on a control package that never streamed, on three real OOXML fixtures, both legs; the request and byte lines are identical between the legs in every phase
accepted_evidence.instructions: callgrind N = 1 / N = 11 isolation pairs on three fixtures, plus callgrind_annotate self-cost tables differenced per symbol
accepted_evidence.correctness_differential: a corpus digest over 179 OOXML packages and 3,450 lines covering every Part's data(), its stream_to(), a second data() taken after that stream, every relationship edge, and three refusal probes per package, byte-identical between the legs; the before leg was run twice first to establish determinism
accepted_evidence.correctness_tests: an exhaustive lookup-equivalence test over every string of length 0 to 4 in {a, /, backslash, ., :} (780 names); a corpus lookup test over 4,215 members and 33,720 spellings with 25,290 payload comparisons; three observation-count invariants in litchi-opc, two of which were confirmed to fail against the pre-change behaviour; a nested-scope test pinning the counting discipline
accepted_evidence.timing: A1 B1 B2 A2 harness runs of docx_file_source_open and pptx_file_source_open, and probe runs of the file-source open, the file-source cold Part read, and the cold reads that follow a stream, each with an A/A floor measured in the same window

accepted_costs.reach_of_the_observation_removal: one observation of five on a cold Part read; on an in-memory source it is a load, and the syscall it costs exists only on FileSource
accepted_costs.monitor_scope_reach: only packages that stream, verify or publish and then keep reading benefit; a package that only reads was already unmonitored
accepted_costs.instruction_accounting: instructions rank work, not latency (change 0579); the canonical scan moves cost into lookup_member_name rather than removing all of it, and the net is what the isolation pair reports
accepted_costs.timing_window: every timing leg ran while seven other agents were building and testing on the same 32-core host at load average 70 or above; the floors are reported and the counts carry the argument
accepted_costs.allocation_failure_path: a canonical lookup can no longer raise ErrorKind::Allocation, because the allocation it guarded no longer happens; no test could observe this without a failing allocator

known_gaps.remaining_observations: part()'s observation is a public-API contract litchi-xlsx depends on; the cold-load closure head and the post-read fence are change 0317's brackets; the post-publication fence is change 0327's. None is reachable by a strict-subset argument, so any further reduction is a contract change needing its own frozen design record
known_gaps.no_file_backed_selector: no perf-baseline selector reads Parts after a publication on a file source, so that shape is measured only by the retained scratch probe
known_gaps.concurrency: the counting discipline is pinned by a unit test, not by a concurrent stress test; change 0583's note that the single-flight proof's concurrency is unexercised still stands
known_gaps.relationship_iteration_order: Relationships::iter() walks a HashMap, so its order varies per process. Found while building the differential; reported, not fixed

withheld: any speedup or regression claim, any RSS or peak-memory claim, any cold-cache, physical-device, range-source, remote-transport, concurrency-scaling or cross-platform result

provenance.host: AMD EPYC 9R45, 32 cores, Linux 7.0.0-1012-aws, rustc 1.95.0, valgrind 3.26.0
